A **new user send** goes through the public export validation. An **internal retry** operates on the tax-automation document IDs already assigned to the workflow.

- The public path rejects a document as `already_sent` when it is uploaded and not archived under the same return type, or `upload_in_progress` when it is waiting/uploading. A failed upload is eligible to pass these checks. Accepted sends create or reuse the matching tax-automation document row. See [validation](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/export/validate_documents.rb:80) and [record reuse](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/export_async.rb:212).
- The Instead workflow receives those existing IDs. Once it finds, links, or creates the entity, `start_uploads` loads the named records and calls `PrepareForSend`, without repeating the public document-selection validation. See [workflow preparation](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/workers/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/documents/export_async_workflow.rb:41).

The internal preparation/reset path is:

1. **Reauthorize and reset the named records.** In one transaction, `PrepareForSend` calls `resend!` when allowed, then `reset!` when allowed, and broadcasts statuses after commit. For a failed upload, this normally means processing `error → sent` and upload `failed → waiting`; the transitions clear the failure reason. It returns the same records. See [preparation](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/documents/prepare_for_send.rb:27) and [state machines](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/models/tax_preparation/tax_automations/document.rb:39).
2. **Reopen the vendor upload safely.** `StartUpload` checks for a held file UUID under that same document **and entity**. If present, it calls `replace_doc_contents`; otherwise it starts a new file. If replacement returns 404, it clears the held UUID and raises `HeldFileLostError`, so the next attempt opens a new file. See [upload selection and recovery](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/documents/start_upload.rb:73).
3. **Transfer, then finalize.** The workflow chains start-upload → transfer-bytes → finalize. A retry of the transfer step itself does **not** rerun preparation: it conditionally calls `upload!`, tolerates an already-`uploading` record, and reuses the buffered signed target. A missing target raises `TargetExpiredError`. See [transfer retry handling](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/documents/transfer_bytes_to_presigned_target.rb:28).

Thus, **workflow re-entry resets the document; a Sidekiq retry of an individual step resumes that step**. Operations have 10 retries per attempt run; throttling can reset that count, so this is not a strict elapsed-time bound. Exhaustion marks affected documents failed. See [retry budget](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/workers/tax_preparation/tax_automations/operation_worker.rb:10) and [failure handling](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/workers/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/export_operation_worker.rb:8).
